Overview, Editions & Hybrid .rsip Architecture

RaggieSoft Installer Studio (Install Without Limits) is a zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 packaging suite targeting Windows 11 x64 and ARM64. Every tool in the suite compiles directly with cl.exe /MT against stock Windows 11 SDK system libraries (msi.dll, cabinet.dll, gdiplus.dll, and Msftedit.dll) so neither your developer workstation nor your customer's PC needs external frameworks pre-installed.

Five Native Binaries in One Suite

  • InstallerStudio.exe: 10-view native Win32 Visual IDE and 5 guided AeroWizards with a 100% comment-preserving AST.
  • instbuild.exe: Headless CLI compiler, sub-millisecond JSON validator, AI spec emitter, and HTML5 VPAT 2.5 generator.
  • SetupWizard.exe: White-label WCAG 2.2 Level AA external-UI bootstrapper with Windows LZMS solid compression, Pre-MSI Runtime Prerequisites, and an authentic Windows Installer SelectionTree.
  • msiprism.exe: Native 64-bit Dark Mode SQL database inspector and differ for .msi, .msm, and .msp packages.
  • RaggieSoftHelp.exe: Zero-dependency native C++20 offline Help Viewer with Named Pipe F1 context navigation, Contents tree, keyword Index, and instant full-text Search.

Product Editions: Community Equals Premier

RaggieSoft Installer Studio defines four IDE edition badges: Community, Express, Professional, and Premier. By permanent architectural design, Community Edition maintains 100% technical feature parity with Premier Edition:

  • Zero locked IDE views, zero disabled CLI flags, and zero artificial feature gates.
  • 100% white-label output: compiled Setup.exe and .msi files carry your own [Package] Manufacturer, product title, icon, and VERSIONINFO with zero visible third-party watermarks.
  • Zero mandatory online accounts, zero background telemetry, and zero cryptocurrency bundles.

Hybrid Project Files (.rsip + .rsis + .rsii)

  1. .rsip (RaggieSoft Installer Project): Standalone plain-text INI-style manifest describing one installer or Merge Module. Comments (; and #) survive GUI edits byte-for-byte.
  2. .rsis (RaggieSoft Installer Suite): Optional multi-project workspace grouping multiple .rsip manifests with shared [Variable] tokens and deterministic BuildOrder sorting.
  3. .rsii (RaggieSoft Installer Include): Optional @include "shared.rsii" header inherited cleanly across projects.
